name: Hotel Pulitzer Amsterdam
positioning: Pulitzer Amsterdam: a hotel made up of twenty-five joined Golden Age canal houses, blending traditional Dutch craftsmanship with modern design among Amsterdam's canals
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside historic Amsterdam canal houses
Families wanting connecting or family rooms and a dedicated kids' programme

facts.text: Pulitzer Amsterdam blends traditional Dutch craftsmanship with modern design, set among the city's canals.
Every room and suite is unique, each differing in size, layout and view.
The Merchant Suite is a spacious suite combining a 17th-century atmosphere with modern comfort.
The Porcelain Collector's suite is adorned with Delftware.
Peter Pulitzer, grandson of the Pulitzer Prize founder, founded the hotel in 1970.
The hotel has serene inner gardens.
The Beauty House offers 111SKIN facial treatments.
Connecting and family rooms with a king bed and two twin beds suit families of four.
The Very Important Kids programme includes welcome snacks, a travel diary, a scavenger hunt through the canal houses and Pulitzer Bedtime Stories.
The hotel has its own bikes.
Restaurant Jansz. serves dishes inspired by modern Dutch cuisine.
Pulitzer's Bar is a space of dark wood and textured copper against the backdrop of the canals.

highlights.text: The hotel is made up of twenty-five joined canal houses dating from the Dutch Golden Age.
Rooms are spread across restored 17th- and 18th-century townhouses connected by long, crisscrossing hallways under a glass roof.
Guests can cruise the canals aboard 'The Tourist', a classic teak boat whose captain shares stories and hidden spots of the city.
Suite categories include Suites, Collector's Suites and Extraordinary Suites.
The Beauty House offers beauty and wellness treatments such as massages, facials, manicures and pedicures.

considerations.text: The fitness facility is a small but stocked gym.
Rooms and suites differ in size, layout and view, so it is worth choosing the room type carefully.
WhataHotel notes the historic building layout may mean compact room sizes.
